rows.whatWasDone: The delivered packet drew a standalone "0" at packet page 7 (313.44, 131.32) and packet page 8 (318.22, 91.2) in both fixtures. Those are the widget rectangles of Value / Valor 11 and Amount Cantidad 15 on component tx-expunction-fee-waiver-statement, the Texas Statement of Inability to Afford Payment of Court Costs approved in Misc. Docket No. 22-9090. Neither value was written by this build. Both are shipped by the official source as /V "0" and were carried onto the filing by the finalizer's structural default, which treats an unwritten /Tx appearance as the court's own ink and preserves it. This family's own production-field-map.json refuses both fields with completenessDisposition REQUIRED_BEFORE_FILING and requiredBeforeFiling true, for the stated reason that the platform holds no financial fact about any participant and a guessed figure on a sworn affidavit is a worse defect than a blank one. That refusal was honoured on the write path and defeated on the flatten path, so a sworn statement of inability to pay went out carrying an answer the participant never gave, on the financial lines, under penalty of perjury.
rows.whyThatRemedy: The two remedies are mirror images and the builder decides which fits. scripts/build-census-v1-rcap-tx-custom-pleading.mjs already imports loadAppearanceSemantics and dispositionsForFamily, already reads the registry once at module load, and already passes appearanceDispositions: dispositionsForFamily(APPEARANCE_SEMANTICS, `${FAMILY_ID}:${source.componentId}`) into finalizeOfficialForm for this exact component -- and passes no clearSourceCarriedTextValues at all. So the mechanism was wired and the entry was under-populated, which is the same finding the sibling repair made on tx_nd_dwi_probation-set. It was confirmed on bytes rather than inferred from the code: the entry already classified Today, and the control build at the unrepaired base dropped Today's 12/15/2022 from the page, proving the registry path is live and effective in this builder before any change of mine. Remedy A is also the one the owner's constraints ask for: it names two fields and states, per field, why each is a participant input rather than the court's ink, leaving every other appearance preserved. Remedy B deletes /V and EVERY widget /AP before flatten, which cannot distinguish the court's own printed ink from a source-carried default and so cannot satisfy 'do not remove a legitimate confirmed zero or any unrelated printed text' by construction.
rows.whyTheseZerosAreNotAnAnswerAnybodyGave: Proved from both ends rather than asserted. From the source end: the issuer-original binary carries these values in the blank form, before any participant sees it -- exactly three of its 132 fields carry a non-empty /V, and they are these two plus Today. From the build end: the family's own field map refuses both fields as REQUIRED_BEFORE_FILING and never writes them, and reports/actual-writes.json listed them under documentAuthoredAppearances with drawnText "0" and sourceValue "0", which is the build's own record that the ink came from the document and not from a participant fact. A zero the participant genuinely answered would appear in actualWrites against a held fact; neither does. No confirmed zero was removed, because there was no confirmed zero.

rows.byteLengthDropIsExplained: canonical went from 959761 (control) to 385141 bytes and boundary from 959995 to 385375, a drop of 574620 bytes that is far larger than the repair looks. It is fully accounted for and it is not content loss. Enumerating every FontFile/FontFile2/FontFile3 in both files shows exactly one font program dropped and none added: the unsubsetted /Arial face, FontFile2, 572464 bytes -- the only face in the file with no subset prefix, and the same face pdftotext cannot map. That it was referenced ONLY by the two deleted appearances was checked rather than assumed: the /Arial FontDescriptor is referenced by exactly one Font dict (232 0 R), and exactly two objects in the whole document map a resource name to it -- 231 0 R and 259 0 R, which are precisely the two appearance XObjects the page dictionaries call /FlatWidget-1812800957 on page 7 and /FlatWidget-4855138939 on page 8. With those deleted nothing references the face, and pdf-lib drops the unreachable stream on save. All ten subsetted faces survive with identical sizes and identical object numbers. Object count fell 325 -> 320, i.e. the two appearance streams, the Font dict, the FontDescriptor and the FontFile2. 574620 - 572464 = 2156 bytes remain, which is those three small objects plus the two removed placement operators in the page content streams and the xref shrinkage.

theThreeNamedObligations.howTheyRelateToThisRepair: VF10's independent verification failed this family on exactly three proof obligations -- KNOWN_PREFILLS, REQUIRED_BEFORE_FILING and SELF_HELP_STOP -- and none of the three is the two-zeros defect. This repair closes a defect that no obligation had named. Two of the three are untouched by it and the third is only partly touched. This row claims none of them as discharged.
theThreeNamedObligations.KNOWN_PREFILLS: NOT ADDRESSED, remains open. VF10 failed it on the date of birth, twice: page 2 prints the raw ISO values 1994-04-17 and 1972-12-31 on a line whose face labels the three positions Month, Day, Year, and the Option 1 date-of-birth line on page 11 stays blank in both fixtures even though the family holds the DOB. This repair removed appearances and added none, changed no write, and left the nine actualWrites per fixture identical. Both defects are still present in the repaired bytes.
theThreeNamedObligations.REQUIRED_BEFORE_FILING: PARTLY ADDRESSED, and the obligation as a whole remains open. This repair closes one REQUIRED_BEFORE_FILING defect: two fields the map correctly refuses under that disposition were nonetheless shipping an answer, because the refusal was honoured on the write path and defeated on the flatten path. Those two lines are now blank. It does NOT close the defect VF10 actually failed the obligation on, which is a different thing: the page-11 Option 1 date-of-birth line must be completed before signing, and it is omitted from the 96 inventoried requiredBeforeFiling refusals and from 'The items you must supply', so the participant-facing list still cannot close every required blank on the delivered form. The inventory is still 96 and still incomplete.
theThreeNamedObligations.SELF_HELP_STOP: NOT ADDRESSED, remains open. VF10 found the eight authoritative track records carry 26 unique self-help stop conditions, of which the shared instruction component omits three common stops -- unclear venue across counties, immigration consequences generally, and trying to attack the underlying case -- and all 17 route-specific stops, while substituting the narrower 'you are not a United States citizen' for the registry's broader 'Immigration consequences.' findingsRaisedNotResolved.what: A registry disposition can sit recorded and unbuilt, and nothing notices.
findingsRaisedNotResolved.evidence: An earlier lane classified Today for this family and the committed fixtures were never rebuilt, so the stale declaration date 12/15/2022 kept shipping on a perjury declaration at packet page 11 in both fixtures, at the tip this lane was dispatched from. The control build at the unrepaired base removed it with no change of mine. verify-source-carried-values-are-dispositioned.mjs reported this family's Today as dispositioned throughout, because it reads the registry and the builder, not the delivered bytes.
findingsRaisedNotResolved.theGap: Nothing asserts that a family's committed fixtures are what its current builder and current registry would produce. A disposition is treated as effective the moment it is written down.
findingsRaisedNotResolved.whatThisLaneDidAboutIt: Reported it. The rebuild fixed it for this family as a side effect, and the placement diff isolates it so it is attributable. It is not fixed for any other family, and this lane did not check whether other families are stale in the same way.

findingsRaisedNotResolved.what: scripts/verify-packet-build-environment.mjs writes its --json report inside the repository even when given an absolute path.
findingsRaisedNotResolved.evidence: path.join(ROOT, REPORT) with REPORT='/tmp/...' produces '<repo>/tmp/...'. The repo has a tracked tmp/ directory, so the report lands beside 1499 committed files.
findingsRaisedNotResolved.theGap: A caller who passes an absolute scratch path gets a file inside the worktree and no warning, and cleaning up that scratch path is then a destructive act against tracked content. This lane hit exactly that and restored it.
findingsRaisedNotResolved.theFixIsOneLine: Use REPORT directly when path.isAbsolute(REPORT), and only join ROOT for a relative path.

counselQuestionsRaisedNotResolved: Every packet delivered from rcap-tx-custom-pleading before this repair carried two sworn zeros on the financial lines of a statement of inability to pay, and a stale 12/15/2022 on the Option 1 declaration under penalty of perjury. Whether any such packet reached a participant, and what is owed if one did, is not a question this lane can answer from the repository.

The declaration date shipped for longer than the zeros did in one sense and less in another: it was classified in the registry by an earlier lane but the fixtures were never rebuilt, so the recorded decision and the delivered bytes disagreed for the whole intervening period. Whoever reviews the first question should be told the record said it was fixed.
